clue.text: Arrival into major road bound to result in an accident

parts.note: the M1 motorway, written MI as crosswords often do

indicators.note: the arrival is put into the word for bound, between its first letter and the rest

parts.note: bound to means sure to
Advent is the coming or arrival of something

explanation.surface: Turning on to a motorway is bound to end in a crash.
explanation.walkthrough: The M1 is Britain's main north-south motorway. The arrival splits the word for bound after its first letter.
explanation.definitionFit: A misadventure is a mishap; death by misadventure is the coroner's verdict for an accidental death.

clue.text: Press coverage suspended at ten for negotiation

indicators.note: the words at and ten are stopped, dropped from the phrase for press coverage

parts.note: the attention the media give to a story
taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: News reporting of talks is halted at ten o'clock.
explanation.walkthrough: 'At ten' looks like a time; it is two words taken as written and removed from the longer phrase.
explanation.definitionFit: Mediation is negotiation conducted through a neutral go-between who helps two sides reach agreement.

clue.text: Philosophy is part of unusual sitcom

indicators.note: is becomes part of the rearranged letters, sitting inside them
an unusual version of the letters of sitcom is a rearranged one

parts.note: the six letters of sitcom, a situation comedy, supply the material to rearrange
taken as written

explanation.surface: Some odd comedy series has a philosophical streak.
explanation.definitionFit: Stoicism is the ancient Greek school of thought teaching calm endurance of hardship.

clue.text: Tandem ride awaits her, if she is willing

definitions.text: Tandem ride awaits her, if she is willing

parts.note: the song promises its heroine a ride on a bicycle built for two
the singer begs her to give him her answer and say yes to marrying him

explanation.surface: A cyclist offers a seat on a two-person bike to a woman, should she agree.
explanation.walkthrough: The old music-hall song Daisy Bell runs: 'Daisy, Daisy, give me your answer, do', ending on a bicycle built for two.
explanation.definitionFit: The woman being courted in the song Daisy Bell, with its tandem bicycle, is named Daisy.

clue.text: Train shortened trip in anger

indicators.note: the shortened trip goes inside the word for anger

parts.note: to anger someone is to enrage them

indicators.note: the trip word loses its last letter

parts.note: a tour is a trip

explanation.surface: A railway journey is cut short, leaving passengers furious.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Train' looks like a railway; it is the definition in its sense of a following.
explanation.definitionFit: An entourage is the retinue of attendants following an important person, just as a train of followers does.

clue.text: Can rising poet reject society?

indicators.note: society is thrown out of the reversed name
in a down entry, rising means the name is read from the bottom up

parts.note: T S Eliot, the poet of The Waste Land

explanation.surface: Might an ambitious poet turn his back on polite company?
explanation.walkthrough: 'Can' looks like the verb; it is slang for a lavatory.
explanation.definitionFit: Can is American slang for a lavatory, and a lavatory is a toilet.

clue.text: Pick up artist is European

parts.note: RA is a Royal Academician, a member of the Royal Academy of Arts
taken as written

explanation.surface: A collector picks up work by a European painter.
explanation.definitionFit: To pick something up is to lift it, which is what raising it means.

clue.text: Parts of camphor gas mixture can be explosive!

definitions.text: Parts of camphor gas mixture can be explosive!

indicators.note: the answer is made of parts of these three words, spanning their joins

parts.note: the run of letters spans the end of camphor, all of gas and the start of mixture

explanation.surface: A chemistry warning: some components of a camphor-gas blend may blow up.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue doubles as a coy description of the answer, so it is read once as wordplay and once as definition.
explanation.definitionFit: An orgasm is a sexual climax, which can be described as an explosive release.

clue.text: United side lacking depth — it looks silly to some

parts.note: united as one

indicators.note: the word side is without the letter for depth

parts.note: taken as written in sense, giving the word side
D is the abbreviation for depth, as in the dimensions of a box

explanation.surface: A football team playing without depth looks foolish to some fans.
explanation.walkthrough: 'United' looks like a football club; it gives one.
explanation.definitionFit: A onesie is a one-piece all-in-one garment for adults that many consider ridiculous to wear.

clue.text: Medium may take daughter in for time to create relationship?

indicators.note: the word for relationship takes the daughter letter in
the daughter letter comes in for, replacing, the time letter

parts.note: a ratio is the relationship between two quantities

explanation.surface: A clairvoyant swaps a family member for an appointment to forge a bond.
explanation.walkthrough: The clue is told backwards: putting time in for daughter in the answer would give the word for relationship.
explanation.definitionFit: Radio is a broadcasting medium, like television or print.

clue.text: Understanding provided by home schooling

parts.note: in means at home
tuition is teaching or instruction

explanation.surface: Home education gives a child real understanding.
explanation.definitionFit: Intuition is understanding gained instinctively, without conscious reasoning.

clue.text: Chaos if chief absconds — any left?

indicators.note: the clue runs in reverse: if the chief leaves the answer, what remains is any
left asks what is remaining once the chief has gone, so the chief sits inside the word any

parts.note: taken as written
arch means chief, as in archbishop or arch-enemy

explanation.surface: If the boss runs off, is there anyone left to keep order?
explanation.walkthrough: The clue describes subtraction from the answer: remove the chief and any is left, so the answer is any with the chief put back inside.
explanation.definitionFit: Anarchy is lawless disorder, a state of complete chaos with no government.

clue.text: Incompetent tennis ace divides America

indicators.note: the tennis player splits the letters for America in two

parts.note: Monica Seles, winner of nine Grand Slam singles titles

explanation.surface: A star tennis player splits American opinion.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Ace' suggests a serve; here it means a champion, Monica Seles.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone useless at a task is hopelessly incompetent at it.

clue.text: Redesigned a Mister Man to be more conventional

definitions.note: the answer means conventional, not a comparative; the setter's 'more' does not quite fit

indicators.note: the letters of a mister man are designed afresh into a new order

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: A Mr Men character is remodelled to appeal to a wider audience.
explanation.walkthrough: Mr Men are a series of children's picture books. The answer is a plain adjective, so 'more' is loose.
explanation.definitionFit: Mainstream describes ideas or tastes held by most people, that is, conventional rather than fringe.

clue.text: Embarrassed by junior officer seen waving on a British vessel

definitions.text: seen waving on a British vessel

parts.note: embarrassment makes the face go red
an ensign is a junior officer, especially in the US Navy

explanation.surface: A blushing junior officer is spotted aboard a British ship.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Seen waving' suggests a person; it is the flag fluttering.
explanation.definitionFit: The Red Ensign is the flag flown by British merchant ships, so it flies over a British vessel.

clue.text: Noble expected to shelter monarch

indicators.note: the word for expected shelters the monarch's letter inside it

parts.note: due means expected, as in a train due at noon
K is the abbreviation for king

explanation.surface: An aristocrat is expected to give the king refuge.
explanation.definitionFit: A duke is a nobleman of the highest rank below a prince.

clue.text: Retrained in Elba?

parts.note: trained afresh in new skills
the island's name read up, as a down entry reads, gives able, which means skilled

explanation.walkthrough: Elba read upwards spells able, so up plus a word for able gives the answer; Napoleon's palindrome 'Able was I ere I saw Elba' helps.
explanation.definitionFit: Workers who are upskilled have been given extra training to improve their abilities.

clue.text: Bath Rome's set out in this place

definitions.text: Bath Rome's set out in this place

indicators.note: set out suggests laying something out, and out alone signals the letters are rearranged

parts.note: the eight letters of these words, without the apostrophe, supply the material

explanation.surface: The Romans laid out the city of Bath here.
explanation.walkthrough: Bath, a spa city founded by the Romans, lies in the English county of Somerset, so the whole clue describes the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: The county of Somerset is the place where the Roman city of Bath was built.

clue.text: Mark seen regularly in serpents with just a silvery appearance

indicators.note: every other letter of serpents is seen, starting from the second

parts.note: the second, fourth, sixth and eighth letters of serpents are the ones taken

explanation.surface: Markings on snakes give them a silvery sheen.
explanation.walkthrough: EPNS stands for electroplated nickel silver, stamped on cutlery that only looks like silver.
explanation.definitionFit: EPNS is the stamp or hallmark on silver-plated ware, a maker's mark.

clue.text: Remove old volume being talked about

parts.note: ex means former, as in ex-wife

indicators.note: spoken, the word for volume gives the sound of the second part

parts.note: size is volume or bulk

explanation.surface: Take out an old book that people are discussing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Volume' looks like a book; it means size.
explanation.definitionFit: To excise is to cut out or remove, as a surgeon removes a growth.

clue.text: Pigs soiled ground? It's hardly earth-shattering news

explanation.surface: Pigs dirtying the ground is a dull bit of farm news.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Ground' looks like the earth the pigs soil; it is the past tense of grind.
explanation.definitionFit: Idle gossip is trivial chatter about other people, the opposite of important news.

clue.text: Spoil plan agent has to make a comeback

indicators.note: coming back, the agent and plan are read in reverse order, from the bottom

parts.note: a rep is a sales representative, an agent
a map is a plan or diagram

explanation.surface: A scheme is ruined when the agent returns.
explanation.definitionFit: To pamper someone is to indulge them, which is to spoil them.

clue.text: Plan to adapt attic to store clubs

indicators.note: the rearranged letters store the clubs letter inside them
adapting the attic means altering its letters into a new form

parts.note: the five letters of attic, a loft room, are the material that gets altered

explanation.surface: A scheme to convert the loft so the golf clubs can be kept there.
explanation.walkthrough: C for clubs is the card-suit abbreviation.

clue.text: International award cheers popular officer

parts.note: a sports player picked for their country is awarded a cap
ta is British informal for thank you
in means fashionable or popular

explanation.surface: A popular military officer is cheered on receiving an international honour.
explanation.definitionFit: A captain is a commissioned officer in the army or navy, or the commander of a ship.

clue.text: One paid to have second puff

mo is a moment, a second, as in 'half a mo'

clue.text: First-class umpire confused start of match

clue.text: Model initiated by party of socialist economic radicals

clue.text: Break down when director is lost for answer

parts.note: to dissolve is to break down into parts
taken as written

explanation.walkthrough: 'Director is lost' reads as a sentence, but the word 'is' itself goes along with D.
explanation.definitionFit: To solve a puzzle is to find its answer, so answer here is a verb.

clue.text: Focussed on a misleading description of homeopathic product?

definitions.meaning: first meaning: giving full attention to one thing
second meaning: strong, not diluted; homeopathic remedies are diluted to near nothing, so the label would mislead

explanation.walkthrough: Homeopathy dilutes its ingredients so heavily that the opposite of the answer would be the honest label.
explanation.definitionFit: Concentrated means focussed with full attention, and also of a substance made stronger by removing water.
